names.en: Rock Mountain Immortal Monkey King Transformation
names.ru: Трансформация в Бессмертного Царя Обезьян Каменной Горы

summary.text: Rock Mountain Immortal Monkey King Transformation is Shi Lei's earth path and transformation path dual immortal killer move.

claims.text: Against Seven Star Child immortal zombie he uses it as his greatest trump card. Golden light bursts out and repels the charge. When the pillar of light vanishes, a sixteen meter tall giant monkey stands in its place.

The monkey has golden fur like golden armor. Its muscles bulge like huge rocks. Its golden pupils hold an emotionless dominance. Its huge hands have red fingernails sharp as swords, and when the fingers extend the hands look like claws. Fangs grow until they protrude from the mouth. In this state he sees through Fang Yuan’s concealment and picks out Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan. One Star Finger pierces the huge body and the monkey only shakes slightly. Star Billow Pillar then hits it on the back and knocks it to the ground.

The golden fur blocks flying sword rat nails. The scratches make a metallic noise and draw no blood. Bunches of fur still fall as the rats keep hacking, and he whips his tail like a golden whip. During the pursuit, Seven Star Child sends blows without pause. Even with the Immortal Monkey King form’s great defense, those blows tear skin and expose flesh. The form is more than twice as large as Fang Yuan’s eight armed immortal zombie. When he forces a hole out of Starry Sky grotto-heaven, his defenses rise by more than ten times, enough to resist the squeeze of the breakthrough. After a burst of sharp golden light, Shi Lei returns to human form.

Zhao Lian Yun names it Shi Lei’s signature killer move while he is already in the giant monkey body. It is a compound killer move of two paths and expends a lot of thoughts. Shi Lei has no wisdom path foundation, so he needs a lot of preparation to use it. After an explosion he had no time to activate it at once. He survived by other methods, then used this move because he could not heal, turning into an ancient desolate beast so that physique’s self-recovery would let him endure the injuries and barely survive. The monkey is like a small mountain. Half the golden fur is blackened, the body is covered in mushy flesh and blood, and bones show in the deeper wounds. He sprawls on the ground and cannot get up. The golden eyes are scattered and lost until he sees Zhao Lian Yun and Old Lord Can Yang.
